# Census of the classes that give a third-party plugin away: which surveyed games ship each one,
# by PROFILE name. Read by plugins_spec to check that every profile declaring a plugin has it and
# every profile having one declares it -- a forgotten declaration is a silent screen, and that is
# the failure this whole layer trades for. Regenerate with build_fangame_census.rb after adding a
# plugin or refreshing a dump. Do not edit by hand.
# format: <DetectionProbe> = <profile>, <profile>...   (empty = no surveyed game ships it)
# A probe is a class name, or Class#method for a plugin that brings no class of its own and is
# only given away by a method it adds to one the engine already has.
# surveyed profiles (14): africanus, anil, armonia, awakening, emerald, infinitefusion, infinitefusion_hoenn, opalo, pokemon_z, realidea, relict, reminiscencia, royal, vanilla
AlbumFotos_Scene = anil, royal
EggMoveLearner_Scene = anil
Ekans_Interface_Main = royal
EncounterList_Scene = anil, emerald, relict, royal
HallOfFameViewerScene = anil, royal
Incubadora = opalo, pokemon_z
ItemCraft_Scene = awakening, emerald, pokemon_z
Log = awakening, realidea, reminiscencia
Logros_Scene = africanus, awakening, pokemon_z, reminiscencia, royal
PokedexListSprite = emerald
PokemonBagPartyPanel = anil, emerald, relict, royal
PokemonGenderSelection = armonia, awakening, realidea
PokemonItemFind_Scene = anil, emerald, reminiscencia, royal
PokemonRegionMap_Scene#updateSpeciesInfo = royal
PokemonSave_Scene#pbUpdateSlotInfo = anil, emerald, infinitefusion, infinitefusion_hoenn, royal
PokemonSummary_Scene#showAbilityDescription = anil, royal
Questlog#pbMain = africanus, awakening, infinitefusion, realidea
RC = emerald
